scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/www && npm install --prefix apps/apply && npm install --prefix apps/board && (python3 -m venv backend/.venv || python -m venv backend/.venv) && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt --disable-pip-version-check --no-input
scripts.dev: concurrently -n www,apply,board,backend -c cyan,green,magenta,blue "npm run dev:www" "npm run dev:apply" "npm run dev:board" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/www run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/apply run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/board run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build:www && npm run build:apply && npm run build:board
scripts.check: npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend && npm run build
